name: TeleAnalytics API
description:
Public, token-authenticated endpoints for search, messages, word frequency, profile summary, quota, and voucher redemption.

Try it out:
1. Get your API key from the Telegram bot (@teleanalytics_bot) via the Settings → API menu.
2. Click Authorize in Swagger UI and enter your API Key.
3. The base URL for all requests is https://api.teleanalyticsapi.app.

Cost: 1 credit per request (Search, Messages, Wordfreq, Profile Summary). Quota and Redeem endpoints do not consume credits.

Success semantics for search: success is true if an entity (user/peer with id) is identified even if groups are empty, or groups are found.
